autonomy_definition: Autonomous bounded operation across MWP source mapping, reconciliation, receipts, reversible projections and fail-closed escalation; never authority bypass or unrestricted irreversible mutation.

acceptance_gates.name: source-discovery-and-mapping
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: New or changed source records are detected, mapped to existing lanes/IDs, and unresolved fields remain BLOCKED.

acceptance_gates.name: canonical-AGI-reconciliation
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: AGI is the only canonical MWP project destination and no future MWP publication targets Hermes.

acceptance_gates.name: identity-and-device-authority
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: The active principal/device/surface is live-authenticated and scoped to the operation.

acceptance_gates.name: active-role-provider-runtime
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: The actual active runtime route is evidenced; local configuration is insufficient.

acceptance_gates.name: kanban-execution-authority
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: A bounded task can be executed only when child/lease/heartbeat are live and scoped.

acceptance_gates.name: projection-and-rollback
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: Every projection is idempotent, reversible, provenance-bearing and read-after-write verified.

acceptance_gates.name: freshness-and-drift-loop
acceptance_gates.pass_condition: The loop runs continuously, reports only changes, and fails closed on stale or divergent surfaces.

completion_rule: AC-01 through AC-07 must be PASS with receipts; any BLOCKED gate keeps overall autonomy status BLOCKED.
owner_boundary: Owner approval remains required for irreversible, broad-scope or authority-changing mutations.
